comment:
§2.4.2, p. 39, lines 513. [note]
From line 513 onwards, the focus becomes too narrow (ie on scheme registries and claims management). The text should be broadened to reflect a wider range of DPI applications relevant to health financing, including revenue collection, FMIS, pooling, strategic purchasing and provider-level financial management.
